details.error_handling: Throws InvalidStateTransitionError on non-permitted transition attempts (30 test combinations verified)

details.precision: Exact integer cents precision using native BigInt arithmetic
details.toCents: Converts dollar numbers/strings to BigInt cents; validates inputs and prevents fractional cent loss
details.toDollars: Formats BigInt cents to two-decimal dollar strings with negative support
details.subCents: BigInt subtraction; guards against underflow by throwing InsufficientFundsError
details.mulCentsBasisPoints: Scales cents by basis points (1 bp = 0.01%) via integer division by 10000n

details.card_active_check: Declines with DECLINED_CARD_INACTIVE when card policy is inactive
details.unicode_normalization: Normalizes merchant names via normalizeUnicodeInput to prevent zero-width space and homoglyph bypasses
details.merchant_whitelist: Case-insensitive whitelist validation after Unicode normalization
details.mcc_whitelist: Restricts transactions to allowed Merchant Category Codes (MCC)
